about.title: Hayward Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Hayward sits where I-880 traffic, Mission Boulevard commuters, and neighborhood streets all meet, and public collision records reflect that mix. In 2025, the most recent final reporting year, the city logged 474 injury collisions, with 658 people hurt and 6 lives lost. Reports cluster on Tuesdays between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m., and the highest counts trace to I-880 in both directions and Mission Boulevard. If one of those numbers is you or someone you love, the paperwork that follows can feel heavier than the crash itself. That is where LawProactive fits. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that matches you with an independent personal injury attorney serving Hayward and Alameda County who takes car accident cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still pursue compensation even if you shared part of the blame. And with a two-year filing window that shrinks to as little as six months when a public agency is involved, reaching out sooner protects your options.

whyChoose.title: Why Hayward Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines Are Tracked From Day One
items.desc: California allows two years to file most car accident claims, but that drops to as little as six months when a city, county, or state vehicle or roadway is involved. The attorney you're matched with will identify which clock applies to your crash.

items.title: Shared Fault Doesn't Shut the Door
items.desc: Because California follows pure comparative fault, your recovery is reduced by your percentage of blame rather than erased. Even a driver found mostly at fault can still pursue a claim.

items.title: Evidence Handled Before It Disappears
items.desc: Dashcam clips, freeway camera footage, and witness memories fade fast. An attorney can move quickly to preserve them and advise you not to give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement that could be used against you.

items.question: I was rear-ended on I-880 near Hayward during the evening commute. Who do I call first?
items.answer: Start with medical care, even if you feel mostly fine, because adrenaline masks symptoms. Then report the crash to CHP if it happened on the freeway, or Hayward Police if it was on city streets. After that, reaching out through LawProactive lets an attorney take over communication with the insurers so you can focus on healing.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps asking me for a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are generally not obligated to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer, and doing so before speaking with an attorney can hurt your claim. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that minimize what their company pays. Politely decline and let your attorney handle those conversations.

items.question: Does it cost anything to use LawProactive or to hire the attorney you connect me with?
items.answer: Using LawProactive is completely free. The independent attorneys in our network handle car accident cases on contingency, which means they are paid a percentage only if your case results in a recovery. If there is no recovery, you owe no attorney fee.
